insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Opopop delivered $47,428 in total sales for Week 46 on 1697 units, with organic revenue holding steady at $33,665 (+0.9% WoW). The Gourmet Popcorn Gift Set led the catalog at $15,625 (+39.8%) as gifting demand builds, while the new Flavor-Wrapped line gained momentum: the Popper Bowl + 4 Flavor Sachets Kit reached $7,736 (+42.3%) and the Super Butter Flavor-Wrapped 6 Sachets grew to $3,517 (+45.1%). Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $8,141.

**Metrics to Watch —** Total sales eased -7.5% WoW from $51,251, driven mainly by PPC revenue moving to $13,762 (-23.1%) as ad spend was pulled back. The Super Butter 6-Pack Pop Cups dipped to $6,828 (-18.5%) on 1474 sessions (-26.5%), although its conversion remains the strongest in the catalog at 31.3% (+9.7%), so restoring traffic is the priority.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $3,624 (prior $4,416) generated $13,762 in PPC revenue for a 3.80x ROAS and 26.3% ACOS, with TACoS improving to 7.6% from 8.62%. Ads converted at 14.51% on a 0.70% ad CTR, showing the account is running lean and efficient with room to scale into proven winners.

**Actions This Week —** We will reinvest budget into Super Butter 6-Pack campaigns to rebuild its sessions, and scale bids on the Gift Set and Flavor-Wrapped Kit where conversion is climbing. We will also test fresh Sponsored Brand and Sponsored Product ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.70% as we head into the holiday season.
